input.reasoning_summary: All three challenges have been refuted by the evidence. H1 challenged whether Power Generation sales actually increased in Q3 2026 - E1 explicitly confirms sales increased. H2 challenged whether data center applications were only a minor contributor - E1 states they were the "primary" driver of the increase in turbines/turbine-related services and large reciprocating engines, which were the "main" contributors to Power Generation sales growth. H3 challenged whether other factors primarily drove the increase - E1 clearly identifies data center applications as the primary driver within the main product categories. The evidence review confirms E1 has EXACT_MATCH period compatibility for Q3 2026 and ENTAILS the claim. No contradicting evidence was found. The initial SUPPORTED verdict remains correct.
